[Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一个穿着蓝色衣服的人帮神农，快给他一种红的灵芝” / Formula: 某人 + 帮/帮助 + 某人 + 做某事；快 + 动词 / Correct: “这时，一个穿着蓝色衣服的人帮助神农，赶快给了他一朵红色的灵芝。” “帮神农” needs an action after it, such as “帮助神农治病.” Also, “快” should be “赶快” here, and a completed action needs “了.” “红色的灵芝” is more natural than “红的灵芝.”

items.reason: “快给” here should express a completed past action, and “赶快给了他一朵红色的灵芝” is grammatical; however, “帮神农” itself does not necessarily require an added verb phrase.
